title: Mixture-of-Experts LLM
description: Sparse transformer architecture utilizing router networks to activate subset parameter paths.
name: Mixture-of-Experts LLM
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models replace standard dense feedforward layers with multiple sparse 'expert' networks. A router network assigns each token to specific experts, enabling scaling parameters while keeping active compute constant.
use_when: Serving highly capable models under restricted request latency and compute-per-token budgets.
avoid_when: Serving on devices with extremely low RAM, as all parameters must reside in memory.
pros: Drastically reduces compute cost per token compared to equivalent-sized dense models.
Allows scaling total parameter counts to trillions.
cons: Extremely high RAM overhead to store inactive expert weights.
Router load-balancing makes distributed training unstable.
Fine-tuning requires specialized clustering and synchronization tooling.

key_hyperparams.name: num_experts_per_token
key_hyperparams.note: Number of experts activated per token during routing. Usually set to 2.
